_readme: Pixelsprout Picks catalogue. See PIXELSPROUT-REWARDS-AND-PICKS.md. Only add products you have verified yourself on Amazon (name, ASIN, region). Never add prices, ratings, discounts or stock. 'image' must be a URL produced by Amazon's own tools (SiteStripe image link or Product Advertising API) on m.media-amazon.com; leave it empty to show the category illustration instead. Products failing validation are skipped by the site. Category cards link to Amazon search results tagged with the existing Associates IDs.
disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

categories.name: Gaming mice
categories.description: Arcade and shooting games reward quick, precise clicks. Look for a comfortable shape for your grip, adjustable DPI and buttons you will actually use.

categories.name: Gaming headphones
categories.description: Horror and atmospheric games are far better with good sound. Comfort over long sessions and a decent microphone matter more than flashy lighting.

categories.name: Controllers
categories.description: Many racing and platform browser games support gamepads. Check that a controller lists PC or browser compatibility before buying.

categories.name: Laptop stands
categories.description: Raising your screen to eye level makes long play sessions easier on your neck. An adjustable height and a stable base are the things to check.

categories.name: Gaming accessories
categories.description: Small upgrades such as a large mouse pad or a wrist rest can make everyday browser gaming more comfortable.

categories.name: Gaming keyboards
categories.description: Plenty of browser games are played on the keyboard. Look for anti-ghosting, a layout you are used to and keys that feel good to you.
